Name: Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat
$Comment: Trick-or-treat: one line this file adds to every conversation on the server, on the screens a
conversation opens on, while Hallow's Eve runs.
Once with Period Daily and PerCharacter true, keyed by OnceId, is kept per character: a player
gets one treat or trick a day from each character they ask, and the line comes back at
midnight UTC. Leave PerCharacter out to make it one knock a day across every character. Season
hides it whenever the event is off. Grant rolls the lootable
Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat, which always pays a few sweets with a notice and then draws one
more treat or a costume trick, and adds a little favor with the Hallowed (Hallows_Eve_Hallowed) (the Reputation
reward; Amount is how much). It names no Goto and no Close, so the conversation stays on the
screen it was on, the line gone for the day, and the library's receipt toast shows inside it:
every thing the knock paid (the treat, the sweets, the favor) as rows, with the pickup sound,
once. Add a Dialogues block with an
Exclude list to keep it out of a conversation, or set Enabled false in a file of the same name
